text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> P1: High tail latency for tenant `lucent-health` (dedicated-us-east-2). 95p latency 2.3s, error rate +1.2% in last 2m. Paging @eng-oncall

oncall-aaron: ack i'm on it. pulling graphs + queue state. pinging @eng-sched-maya and @sre-lee

oncall-aaron: seeing steady enqueue on gpn-04, qps ~700, avg batch size 2.2, lots of tiny batches. tail tokens spiking (~1.5x). looks like tenant-level shaper/knob is creating fragmentation

eng-sched-maya: can you dump tenant knobs? my hunch is max_batch_tokens is too low (we saw defaults at 512). if so we should bump to 4096 + enable burst coalesce to let short fanout coalesce. prepping a safe override plan

oncall-aaron: lucent-eng @lucent-eng any traffic changes on your side? product-jay?

lucent-eng: we shipped a client-side micro-change at 14:48 that fans out many short prompts to multiple agents. rolling that back now (started 14:59).

sre-lee: applying temp shaper override now: `shaper apply --tenant lucent-health --max-batch-tokens 4096 --burst-window 200ms --reason "temp mitigate small-batch storm"` -> will monitor

incident-bot: ACTION LOG: shaper override applied by sre-lee at 5544332220

oncall-aaron: nice — 95p tail dropped from 2.3s -> 420ms within 45s. error rate trending to baseline. CPU on gpn-04 still high, but enqueue backlog decreasing

eng-sched-maya: starting canary scheduler rollout for tenant override (10% paths): `scheduler-config create --tenant lucent-health --canary 0.1 --max_batch_tokens 4096` — will watch coalescing metrics + token-per-batch distribution

product-jay: CS reports some Lucent users saw timeouts prior to rollback, account team looped in enterprise-SL. we should send a customer update after mitigation confirmed

oncall-aaron: agreed — notifying CS/account. status: mitigated via shaper override + client rollback in progress. next steps: persist shaper change or tune permanently, follow-up postmortem. pinging @cs-olivia to draft customer note

cs-olivia: acknowledged, drafting short note: "Mitigated — temporary scheduler override + client rollback reduced latency; follow-up postmortem and permanent knob changes forthcoming."

lucent-eng: rollback in progress, ETA ~5m. will confirm when release completes

sre-lee: leaving shaper override active until morning to be safe. i'll also attach diffs to the incident doc and export batch-size histograms to the runbook

oncall-aaron: handing to night oncall @oncall-jen for follow-up (root-cause + longer-term knob). please validate override persisted and coordinate with sched team for a controlled permanent change

oncall-jen: ack i'll take it. will verify config, add follow-up ticket for sched + docs, and set a 09:00 follow-up with lucent account team

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATE -> P2 (mitigated) at 5544332250

oncall-aaron: notes: suspected root cause = sudden client fanout producing many short prompts -> extreme micro-batching causing scheduling overhead; immediate mitigation = increase max_batch_tokens + burst coalesce; follow-ups: permanent knob tuning, client guidance, add alert for avg batch size < 3 under >200 qps to auto-detect similar regressions

sre-lee: uploading logs + shaper diff to /incidents/5544332211 in drive. will add graphs for token-per-batch and enqueue latency.

eng-sched-maya: adding a test in our integration harness to emulate high short-prompt fanout and validate our coalesce heuristics.

oncall-jen: will own the postmortem. leaving a short status update for customer and scheduling a 1-hour review with sched + lucent next biz day. :white_check_mark:
